sample_unit: patients with multiple sclerosis (MRI scans from seven centers)

links.outcome: Between-center reliability (ICC) of lesion detection on AI-generated DIR and PSIR images
links.effect: Reliability was good across centers: ICC 0.81 for AI-generated DIR and 0.75 for AI-generated PSIR, in a seven-center sample.
links.quote: Reliability was good for both DIR (ICC, 0.81) and PSIR (ICC, 0.75) across centers.

screen.reason: Multicenter reader study evaluating whether generative adversarial networks (GANs) can synthesize MRI sequences (DIR and PSIR) suitable for clinician lesion detection. Tests model clinical utility via a multi-reader validation, but does not test a deployment practice or safeguard.
